values: Events with 'VOIDED' in their description are no longer active and must be excluded from all conflict detection.
Events with 'CANCELLED' in their description have been withdrawn and must not be counted as active bookings for conflict purposes.

body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_12\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nParking lot B re-striping scheduled for this weekend. Please park in Lot C."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080016.000016\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_16\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nPest control visit scheduled for Thursday evening after business hours."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_01\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nGood morning ops team. Facilities checklist for today is posted in #facilities-daily."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080005.000005\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_05\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nAnyone know if the badge printer in reception is fixed? Still showing paper jam."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080022.000022\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_22\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nSafety shoe replacement vouchers available from EHS. See Lydia for details."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080024.000024\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_24\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nThe recycling compactor is jammed again. Maintenance ticket submitted."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080003.000003\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_03\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nReminder: fire drill at 2 PM today. Please make sure all exits are clear."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080023.000023\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_23\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nCompressed gas cylinder audit completed. All tags current."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_17\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nThe roof leak in Building C has been patched. Monitoring for 48 hours before closing the ticket."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080006.000006\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_06\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nNew vendor onboarded: GreenField Environmental. Insurance certs verified."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080015.000015\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_15\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nWeekly ops metrics: Work orders closed: 47. Average resolution time: 6.2 hours. Great work everyone!"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080010.000010\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_10\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nFleet update: Vehicle F-207 in for service today. Using F-210 as backup."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080013.000013\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_13\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nNew hire orientation: 3 new warehouse staff starting Monday. Badge photos at 8 AM."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080004.000004\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_04\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nGenerator test completed ✅ All 3 units passed. Logs uploaded to CMMS."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_14\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nHVAC filter replacement complete for Building A. Next round: Building C on March 10."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080020.000020\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_20\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nVendor scorecard review meeting at 3 PM. Please review the Q1 reports beforehand."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080019.000019\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_19\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nConference room 301 AV equipment upgraded. New wireless casting system is live."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_21\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday/Friday. Nina is covering warehouse ops."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080025.000025\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_25\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nEmergency lighting test completed for all buildings. 2 bulbs replaced in Building D stairwell."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080008.000008\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_08\", \"channel_id\": \"COFF\"}\nElevator B back in service after maintenance. Thanks to the ElevatorPlus team for the quick turnaround."}
